name: explain-the-fix
description: Explains a just-finished coding task (bug fix, refactor, new feature) as a small, proportional diagram instead of a wall of text — built for vibe coders who lose track of what an AI agent actually changed. Renders a self-contained dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagram with a clickable glossary for jargon.

interface.shortDescription: Explain a just-finished code change as a small diagram, not a wall of text.
interface.longDescription: Explains a just-finished coding task (bug fix, refactor, new feature) as a small, proportional diagram instead of a wall of text — built for vibe coders who lose track of what an AI agent actually changed. Classifies the diff into a causal chain, before/after refactor, sequence flow, or vertical deep-dive (cause → fix → why it works), then renders a self-contained, dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagram with a clickable glossary for any jargon in the labels.
defaultPrompt: Visualize the fix you just made.
